title: Bias and Fairness in AI: Talk + Networking | DSPT Aveiro
description:
Aveiro, we're back! 🛶

We're continuing DSPT's 10-year celebrations with Sérgio Jesus from Feedzai and a conversation about bias and fairness in AI. Join us at DETI for the talk, bring your questions, and stick around for networking and bites.

Agenda
18:00–18:10 · Get together
18:10–18:20 · Welcome by DSPT
18:20–19:15 · Talk + discussion
19:15–20:30 · Networking and bites

The talk
Bias and Fairness in AI: An Overview
Sérgio Jesus \| Feedzai

How can we tell if an AI system is treating people unfairly? And what can we do about it?

Sérgio will walk us through examples of what can go wrong, how to choose fairness metrics that fit the problem, and the choices involved in balancing fairness and model performance.

We'll also look at open-source tools for checking models and reducing bias before, during and after training.

📅 October 27, 2026 · 18:00–20:30
📍 DETI, University of Aveiro · Anfiteatro V

Free and open to everyone. Whether you work with AI or are just curious, we'd love to have you there.

See you in Aveiro! 💛
